import os
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import requests


ASSEMBLYAI_BASE_URL = "https://api.assemblyai.com/v2"


def submit_audio(audio_path: str, api_key: str) -> str:
    headers = {"authorization": api_key}
    with open(audio_path, "rb") as f:
        upload = requests.post(
            f"{ASSEMBLYAI_BASE_URL}/upload",
            headers=headers,
            data=f,
            timeout=120,
        )
    upload.raise_for_status()
    return upload.json()["upload_url"]


def create_transcript(upload_url: str, api_key: str) -> str:
    headers = {"authorization": api_key, "content-type": "application/json"}
    payload = {"audio_url": upload_url, "speaker_labels": True}
    response = requests.post(
        f"{ASSEMBLYAI_BASE_URL}/transcript",
        headers=headers,
        json=payload,
        timeout=120,
    )
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()["id"]


def poll_transcript(transcript_id: str, api_key: str) -> dict:
    headers = {"authorization": api_key}
    while True:
        response = requests.get(
            f"{ASSEMBLYAI_BASE_URL}/transcript/{transcript_id}",
            headers=headers,
            timeout=120,
        )
        response.raise_for_status()
        data = response.json()
        status = data.get("status")
        if status == "completed":
            return data
        if status == "error":
            raise RuntimeError(data.get("error", "AssemblyAI transcription failed"))
        time.sleep(5)


def format_diarized_transcript(data: dict) -> str:
    utterances = data.get("utterances") or []
    if utterances:
        lines = []
        for item in utterances:
            speaker = item.get("speaker", "Unknown")
            text = item.get("text", "").strip()
            if text:
                lines.append(f"Speaker {speaker}: {text}")
        return "\n".join(lines)
    text = data.get("text", "")
    return text


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Request speaker diarization for a recorded meeting using AssemblyAI.")
    parser.add_argument("audio_file", help="Path to the recorded meeting audio file")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    api_key = os.environ.get("ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY")
    if not api_key:
        print("Missing ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY environment variable", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    audio_path = Path(args.audio_file)
    if not audio_path.is_file():
        print(f"Audio file not found: {audio_path}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    upload_url = submit_audio(str(audio_path), api_key)
    transcript_id = create_transcript(upload_url, api_key)
    transcript = poll_transcript(transcript_id, api_key)
    print(format_diarized_transcript(transcript))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())","lineStart":1,"lineEnd":94,"totalLines":94,"truncated":false}},"title":"private/var/folders/bf/pt_kfhl16yb4r9vfb588n1fm0000gn/T/vb-staged-00xwm1s5/diarized_transcript.py","time":{"start":1789821107955,"end":1789821107962}},"metadata":{"openai":{"itemId":"fc_0c5a0a7944fd39bd016aae80b32b3087d28893261b1ebe34da"}},"id":"prt_0b9a6bc5f0018SJLlCo8KXDQfl","sessionID":"ses_f4659504cffe5rYJn6LnzOdT1L","messageID":"msg_0b9a6b86f001ul6eLGU0GjVUld"}}

+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from typing import Any
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def _normalize_word_timestamps(words: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    normalized = []
+    for word in words:
+        normalized.append(
+            {
+                "word": word.get("word"),
+                "start": word.get("start"),
+                "end": word.get("end"),
+                "confidence": word.get("confidence"),
+            }
+        )
+    return normalized
+
+
+def _normalize_segment_timestamps(segments: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    normalized = []
+    for segment in segments:
+        normalized.append(
+            {
+                "start": segment.get("start"),
+                "end": segment.get("end"),
+                "text": segment.get("text"),
+            }
+        )
+    return normalized
+
+
+def get_timestamps(transcription_result: Any, granularity: str = "word") -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    if hasattr(transcription_result, "model_dump"):
+        data = transcription_result.model_dump()
+    elif isinstance(transcription_result, dict):
+        data = transcription_result
+    else:
+        data = transcription_result.__dict__
+
+    segments = data.get("segments") or []
+    words: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for segment in segments:
+        segment_words = segment.get("words") or []
+        if segment_words:
+            words.extend(segment_words)
+
+    if granularity == "segment":
+        return _normalize_segment_timestamps(segments)
+    if granularity == "word":
+        return _normalize_word_timestamps(words)
+    raise ValueError("granularity must be 'word' or 'segment'")
+
+
+def _load_transcription_result(path: str) -> Any:
+    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+        return json.load(f)
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Return word or segment timestamps from an OpenAI transcription result.")
+    parser.add_argument("transcription_result", help="Path to a JSON transcription result or audio file")
+    parser.add_argument("--granularity", choices=("word", "segment"), default="word")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+
+    try:
+        if args.transcription_result.lower().endswith(".json"):
+            result = _load_transcription_result(args.transcription_result)
+        else:
+            with open(args.transcription_result, "rb") as audio_file:
+                result = client.audio.transcriptions.create(
+                    model="gpt-4o-mini-transcribe",
+                    file=audio_file,
+                    response_format="verbose_json",
+                    timestamp_granularities=[args.granularity],
+                )
+        timestamps = get_timestamps(result, args.granularity)
+    except Exception as exc:
+        print(str(exc), file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+
+    print(json.dumps(timestamps, ensure_ascii=False))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
